title: agent-hub Agent Integration Protocol v1
description: What a user-defined agent (adapter.json without a code adapter) sends to the hub: the hook envelope v1 (schema/hook-envelope.v1.json) with a protocol event name and a camelCase payload. Sent through `agenthub-hook --agent <id> --event <event> [--session <id>] [--json <payload>]` or `POST /v1/events`. Unknown fields are ignored; unknown events are accepted and change nothing. See docs/agent-protocol.md.

v.description: Envelope version. Any other value is rejected.

receivedAt.description: Event time; the sidecar sets it. Default: when the hub read the event.

tsMs.description: Event time as Unix ms, used when receivedAt is absent.

paneId.description: AGENTHUB_PANE_ID of the agent-hub terminal; the sidecar adds it.

payload.description: Event fields (below). Missing or null reads as {}.

sessionId.description: The agent's session id (`--session` sets it). Missing: `pane:<paneId>`; missing outside a pane: the event is rejected.

cwd.description: Working folder; the session's project is its git root.

tool.description: Tool running now (shown on the session card).

command.description: Shell command waiting for approval; kept in memory only, never stored or logged.

path.description: File the tool wants to change; in memory only.

risk.description: The agent's own risk label. Any other value is ignored and the hub classifies `command` itself.

question.description: Never reaches the hub: agenthub-hook replaces it with question_length.

message.description: Short error text (clipped to 500 chars); read for a usage limit's reset time, not stored.

inputTokens.description: Input tokens of one model call, without the cached ones.

cachedTokens.description: Input tokens read from the provider's cache.

costUsd.description: The agent's own cost for the call. Absent: priced from pricing.json (or no cost).
